'''Deel''' was the molten first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Neimoidia system/Legends|Neimoidia system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] region, where it [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Nen (star)/Legends|Nen]].<ref name="TEA" />
